Bihar Election 2025: Super Cops Quit Jobs, Entered Politics – But Crashed in 1st Inning! | Full Breakdown
This time in Bihar Assembly polls, top bureaucrats took VRS & jumped into the ring. Heroes in uniform – mafia raids, crime crackdowns, bold public decisions – but their political debut? Ended before it began! First election, massive defeat. Who were they? Jai Prakash Singh (IPS) – Chapra (Jan Suraj) – 2,514 votes, 4th
R.K. Mishra (Ex-IG) – Darbhanga (Jan Suraj) – Lost
Shivdeep Lande (IPS, 'Singham') – Araria (Independent) – 3rd/4th
B.K. Ravi (IPS) – Rosera (Congress) – Lost
